name: Vivre Kokoro kara no Egao
source:
A common male and female relationship. But she suddenly dies. Main character denies everything with grief and becomes despised. His lover continues to exist in this world as a ghost, and she wishes to see her former partner cheerful again. For that she is determined to get him a partner in school trip to Kyoto with the use of body possession.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这原本只是一段平凡的男女关系，她却突然去世了。主人公因悲痛而否定一切，逐渐惹人厌恶。恋人化作幽灵继续存在于世，她希望看见昔日的爱人重新振作起来。为此，她决定在京都修学旅行期间借助附身他人的能力，为主人公找到一位伴侣。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
